rationale: After an initial shallow pullback to $9.94 that found support well above the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($9.88) and session VWAP ($9.57), price has formed a higher low on the 1-minute chart and returned to the $9.99-$10.00 level on expanding volume. Relative strength against the broader market (-4.19% SPY) remains intact with 19 minutes to the close, supporting a hold for another test above $10.00 while the $9.89 invalidation protects downside.
